title: Play the Next Ball
style: world jazz, female lead vocal, kora and brass, walking bass, 92 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball coaching anthem, uplifting choir, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO]
(spoken)
The score is just a number.
Your attitude is the real scoreboard.
In every language, same truth.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Two one two, keep your head
Never count the points with dread
Play each ball like it's the first
Mindset steady at its best

[VERSE 2 - Tigrinya transliteration -- new verse different from Court of World]
Kab hade netsanet nay xibar aytkonen
Aytehazel nay miets b'tseriat
Kulu kueso kemti qedamit elayo
Hawiskha ezi kemzigbaekha zelon

[VERSE 3 - Malagasy transliteration]
Roa iray roa, tehirizo ny lohanao
Aza isaina ireo isa amin-tahotra
Kaloka tsirairay toy ny voalohany
Mindset matotra amin'ny tsara indrindra

[CHORUS]
SCORE - POAINGANA - SKOR - HESAB
MINDSET FIRST - HOLD YOUR LINE
TWO ONE TWO - EVERY GAME
PLAY EACH BALL - EVERY TIME

[VERSE 4 - Welsh]
Dau un dau, cadwch eich pen
Peidiwch byth cyfri'r pwyntiau ag ofn
Chwaraewch bob pel fel y cynta
Meddylfryd cadarn ar ei orau

[VERSE 5 - Tswana transliteration]
Pedi nngwe pedi, tshola tlhogo
O se ke wa bala dintlha ka boifa
Bapala bolo nngwe le nngwe jaaka ya ntlha
Mmele wa mogopolo o tsepame

[VERSE 6 - Corsican transliteration]
Dui uni dui, tena a testa
Non cuntà mai i punti cun timori
Ghjoca ogni palla cum'è a prima
Mentalità stabile à u so megliu

[CHORUS]
SCORE - POAINGANA - SKOR - HESAB
MINDSET FIRST - HOLD YOUR LINE
TWO ONE TWO - EVERY GAME
PLAY EACH BALL - EVERY TIME

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Malagasy. Welsh. Tswana. Corsican.
The score changes every rally.
Your mindset stays constant.
Play the next ball.

[FINAL CHORUS]
SCORE - POAINGANA - SKOR - HESAB
MINDSET FIRST - HOLD YOUR LINE
TWO ONE TWO - EVERY GAME
PLAY EACH BALL - EVERY TIME
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE FOCUS
PLAY THE NEXT BALL - EVERY TIME

[OUTRO]
Every language. Every court.
Play the next ball.
